div.head: Mr. Bigelow to Mr. Molard
div.p: Sir: I have the honor to acknowledge the receipt of the letter which you have been pleased to address to me in the name of the “Masonic Lodge of Triumphant Friends.” I beg you to accept personally and to transmit to the lodge all my thanks for the marks of sympathy which it has pleased to give to my country and its government on the occasion of our great national mourning.
Accept, sir, the assurance of my distinguished sentiments.
